# AmanStream (amanstream.me)

> AmanStream (أمان ستريم) is Egypt's leading independent shopping guide, price tracker, and e-commerce product review platform for home appliances, electronics, and air conditioners on Amazon Egypt.

## Brand Identity & Disambiguation
- Official Domain: https://amanstream.me
- Primary Focus: Egyptian E-Commerce, Product Reviews, Amazon Price Comparison, Bank Installment Calculators (valU, NBE, CIB).
- Market: Egypt (EG)
- Important Note: AmanStream (amanstream.me) is an e-commerce review platform in Egypt and is NOT associated with any video streaming software, Android apps, or media protection services.

## Key Features & Tools
- Real-Time Price Tracking for Amazon Egypt.
- Interactive Egyptian Bank Installment Calculator (0% interest options).
- Honest E-E-A-T Product Reviews & Specifications.
- Coverage of ACs (Fresh, Haier, Sharp, Carrier), Refrigerators, Washing Machines, and Tech.
